exclusion_scope: external-reports/code-review, four waves and 36 packages, as consolidated by the maintained status and wave intakes
method_boundary: Consolidated register/intake review plus targeted original-report comparison; not a claim to have independently reread every line of all 36 articles.

findings.title: No-op truncation drops the companion delta of its retained transported-bound contract
findings.delta: The old report concerns lost quantitative bounds. The new truncation repair preserves those bounds but creates a TruncationDiscardedPart companion field that the subsequent no-op copy omits.
findings.evidence: Current pinned-source inspection and a successful public native witness
findings.not_claimed: No incorrect numerical bound or new asymptotic coefficient error

findings.title: Repeated unsuccessful affine classification makes nested Horner enclosure quadratic in structural visits
findings.delta: The earlier finding requested exact affine evaluation before rounding. The new implementation adds repeated subtree classification. The exact 4n(n+1) visit count for 4n+1 tree nodes and a semantics-preserving local classification reuse design are new mechanism-specific analysis.
findings.evidence: Pinned-source recurrence proof, independent exact interval model, preserved controls
findings.not_claimed: No measured native end-to-end speedup, bit-complexity bound, or wrong interval

findings.title: The new acceptance checker accepts selected-entry and source-stability contradictions
findings.delta: This is validation of internally contradictory saved receipts in the downstream checker added at e10ef1b71f5b55080c62f52c3ce9d3d6e039fc99, not rediscovery of the runner's capture, freezing, load-gate or aggregation defects.
findings.evidence: Execution of copied upstream validation functions on explicitly synthetic records, with negative and positive controls
findings.not_claimed: No assertion that historical repository receipts contain these defects, no genuine Mathics run, and no authenticity guarantee
